title: Receipt body: dispatch.session-input.accepted
description: One input was placed durably in a session's canonical input sequence. It proves acceptance, never delivery to the model nor a reply. See spec/session-messages.md.

input_id.description: Chosen by the client and reused on retry, so a retried input is accepted once.

input_sequence.description: The input's place in the session's one input order, whichever client sent it.

message_id.description: The operator message the input became, once that message is recorded.
